roads.name: Trails End Camp Road
words: Properly twisty: 28 curves in 5.5 miles, about 5 a mile.
About 4 miles in the middle are tamer.
The curves flow straight into one another.
From 450 to 1,218 ft, with 1,220 ft of up and down along the way.
roads.ratingNote: A full bar is top marks for that part; the percentages are each part's share of the rating. Curves, length and up and down are ranked against every road in the library. The rest are scored on the road itself: how few side roads join it, whether the curves or the limit set the pace, and how little is built up along it. At the 55 mph limit its corners still ask for about 1.04 g, so the curves, not the limit, set the pace. Most of it has no posted limit on the map, so this takes California's 55 mph.

roads.name: Parker Dam Road
words: Sweeping and steady: 24 curves in 6.1 miles.
The 3 miles at the south end are tamer.
From 383 to 511 ft, with 640 ft of up and down along the way.
8 parks, trailheads and other stops along it, so it's likely busier than most, especially on weekends.
